properties.notes: PLAN/2016/0742 mixed use application detailed. In this case, the min net dwellings is based on indicative density derived from the SHLAA Methodology 2017 Appendix 4, and accounting for the mix of uses on the site, rather than the application detailed.. Demolition and clearance of the site and erection of a phased development comprising 560 residential units, 10,582 sqm of offices, 843 sqm of retail and gym use (A1-A4 and D2) with 395 parking spaces, public realm improvements and highway works to Goldsworth Road. Block A to comprise ground plus 34 storeys, Block B comprising ground plus 25 and 20 storeys, and Block C comprising ground plus 17, 14 and 10 storeys.
